description: Hybrid post-quantum cryptography for TypeScript and JavaScript.
rules: Outside Node.js call await init() once before use.
Pass a context when signing and expectedContext when verifying; pass aad when sealing and expectedAad when opening.
Free secret objects with using or free(), and wipe() any exported secret bytes.
The default hybrid signature suite is Ed25519+ML-DSA-65-v2; the default hybrid KEM is X25519+ML-KEM-768.
